title: Ludwigsburg University of Education
description: The largest university of education in Baden-Württemberg, training teachers and education professionals in a baroque town north of Stuttgart.
html:
The university in numbers

Around 5,500 students, five faculties and a campus on the edge of a baroque residence town 20 minutes from Stuttgart. Ludwigsburg is the largest of the state's universities of education, the institutions that train Germany's primary and secondary school teachers.

What it offers

Teacher training for primary, secondary and special-needs education is the core, alongside programmes in adult education, cultural education and educational science. Most teaching is in German, which reflects the profession, but the international office runs exchange programmes and supports incoming students with language courses. The town itself is compact and safe, with a large palace, a film academy and a student population that keeps the centre lively.

Faculties

  • Education and social sciences
  • Languages, literature and the arts
  • Natural sciences and mathematics
  • Culture and cultural education
  • Special education

Health insurance for students

Like every German university, Ludwigsburg requires proof of health insurance at enrolment. Students under 30 usually join the statutory system; EC Assets arranges the cover before you arrive so that the certificate is ready for enrolment.
